title: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

scope.heading: 1. Scope of the Service
scope.body: This platform provides AI-assisted interview practice and pre-assessment. Its purpose is to help you practice; the generated questions, answer evaluations and reports are not a substitute for a real hiring decision.

account.heading: 2. Account and Usage Rules
items: You must provide accurate and current information when registering.
You are responsible for the security of your account; never share your password.
Do not enter another person's personal data into the platform without their permission.
Do not overload the service with automated tools, reverse engineer it, or attempt to bypass its security measures.
Do not use the service to generate abusive, discriminatory or unlawful content.

aiContent.heading: 3. AI-Generated Content
aiContent.body: Interview questions, hints and assessment reports are generated by large language models. This content may be inaccurate, incomplete or misleading; its correctness is not guaranteed. Do not base your career decisions solely on these outputs.

intellectualProperty.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.body: The platform's interface, design and source code belong to its developers. The answers you give during an interview remain yours; you grant us the limited right to use them as needed to operate the service and produce your reports.

termination.heading: 5. Suspension and Termination
termination.body: If these terms are violated, access to your account may be restricted or terminated. You may also permanently delete your account at any time from the Settings page.

liability.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: The service is provided "as is". It is not guaranteed to be uninterrupted or error-free. No liability is accepted for indirect damages arising from use of the service.

privacyCollected.heading: 7. Privacy — Data We Collect
items: Account information: name, email, password (only in hashed form) or Google account ID
Usage data: your interview answers, generated questions, assessment reports and pre-assessment responses
Technical data: IP address, browser and device information

privacySharing.heading: 8. Privacy — Use and Sharing
privacySharing.body: Your data is used to deliver the service, produce assessments and measure service quality. Your interview answers are shared with the Groq and DeepSeek AI service providers so that assessments can be generated. If you choose to sign in with Google, only your name and email address are received from Google. Your data is never sold to third parties for advertising.

privacyCookies.heading: 9. Cookies and Local Storage
privacyCookies.body: A strictly necessary session cookie is used to keep you signed in. Your language and theme preferences are stored in your browser's local storage. No third-party advertising or tracking cookies are used.

privacyRetention.heading: 10. Retention and Deletion
privacyRetention.body: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active, and for 2 years after the assessment. When you delete your account, your name and email along with your interviews, reports and pre-assessment records are permanently deleted; this action cannot be undone.

changes.heading: 11. Changes
changes.body: This document may be updated from time to time. You will be notified in the application when a significant change is made.

contact.heading: 12. Contact
contact.body: You can send questions about these terms or privacy to support@smart-interview.me.
